connector.name: Apogeoapi MCP
connector.registryDescription: Geographic data API: 250+ countries, 150K+ cities, IP geolocation, 161 live FX rates.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.apogeoapi. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
